newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree says MDS deal part of diversification.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree says MDS deal part of diversification.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Monday its agreement to acquire the Manufacturer and Dealer Services (MDS) division of the FINOVA Group Inc is part of its diversification strategy.

"This acquisition represents a continuation of Green Tree's successful diversification into new finance markets where we can take advantage of existing company skills, such as superior credit decision making, efficient loan servicing and regular loan securitization," Lawrence Coss, chairman, said in a statement.
FINOVA previously reported it had entered into a definitive agreement to sell MDS to Green Tree Financial for about $610 million.
In a statement, Green Tree estimates the current value of the deal at about $600 million. John Dolphin, Green Tree vice president, said the final value of the deal will be determined at closing.
MDS provides sales finance programs for several types of equipment, including telecommunications, office equipment, computers and peripherals, commercial laundry, and automotic diagnostics.

"The acquisition of the MDS operation is a compelling strategic development for Green Tree and its shareholders," Coss said. "In addition to immediately putting Green Tree among the top providers of equipment leasing programs in the United States, the operation will benefit greatly from Green Tree's vast experience in working closely with dealers and manufacturers."
Green Tree had a loan portfolio of $18 billion as of September 30.
